I didn't at the reviews when I booked because I knew the brand so I assumed it was just as good as the other one but the day before arriving I saw all the bad reviews online and got scared about the quality of this place. Do not listen to stupid tourists complaining about their own reservations that they booked without doing research. They complained about not being placed in the same room than the people they booked with, suprise suprise first the hotel has private rooms that you can get and if you get the capsules beds then the hotel will place you according to the availability just like any capsule hotel does, if you want to absolutely be together book something else than a capsule because that's how it works. There is also no point wanting to be in the same room because of the very concept of a capsule which is to sleep in and that's all, you do not talk in the rooms neither meet up your capsule with others because that would wake up other clients in the rooms, you always go to common places like the living room with other people to talk, call eat etc so you will have a place to spend time with your friends. People complain about the beds, again this is a capsule bed not a premium spa place the beds are efficient, yes it's not the thickness of a luxury bed but it is well enough for sleeping.

I stayed for nearly two weeks, I'm certain that had I not asked for the extra duvet early on, I'd be bruised and sore by the end. It's possible you might manage for just a few nights, but it's not comfortable, especially after a long flight. This is your warning, I'd consider the bed a health risk. Before adding the padding, my back was killing me and my waist and shoulders hurt when lying down. The lockers are tall and thin. You can hang a shirt or coat in there, but you won't be securing your luggage beyond having the room locked. Even standard carry-on/cabin bags are too wide, suitcases are way out. You might be able to slide stuff under the bed if you have a bottom bunk; otherwise, it's going in the corner. Personally, i think this is easily improved with a two up two down setup to trade the excess height for sufficient width. Regulating the temperature inside the bunks at night wasn't good, but to be fair, it's hard to criticise them on that. Nice place. If it weren't for the bed, my review would be far higher.
